questions.lead: The Atlantic hurricane season opened on June 1, and by the middle of September not one hurricane had formed. Forecasters name El Niño in the Pacific Ocean as a big factor.
questions.prompt: How long has the satellite-era record run without an Atlantic hurricane lasted?

questions.lead: The national bank of Kyrgyzstan says the country has started printing its own banknotes at home for the first time since independence.
questions.prompt: What is the currency of Kyrgyzstan called?

questions.lead: No hurricane has formed in the Atlantic this season, a run that forecasters call a record for the satellite era. Seasons this quiet are very rare.
questions.prompt: Which year held the previous record for a season this quiet?

questions.lead: Researchers at Binghamton University set a mathematical way of playing Wordle against the familiar tactic of opening with common letters.
questions.prompt: What share of Wordle puzzles did the mathematical method solve in simulations?

questions.lead: The Binghamton strategy does not always chase the likeliest answer. It picks the guess expected to cut the field of remaining words down the most.
questions.prompt: Which measure of uncertainty does the strategy rely on?

explanations: The season has reached 103 days without a hurricane, a record for the satellite era. Forecasters point to El Niño in the Pacific Ocean as a big factor.
The currency is the som, and its banknotes are now being printed inside Kyrgyzstan. The Kyrgyz National Bank says it is the first time since independence.
The last Atlantic season to stay this quiet was 1941. This season started on June 1 and has now reached 103 days without a hurricane.
The information theory method solved 99% of Wordle puzzles in simulations. A strategy built on common letters solved 90%.
The strategy uses Shannon entropy, a mathematical way of measuring uncertainty. It shows how much useful information a particular choice is expected to reveal.

sources.excerpt: The Atlantic hurricane season reaches a 103-day record in the satellite era without a hurricane after the season started on June 1, the first since 1941, with the El Niño in the Pacific Ocean being a big factor.
The Kyrgyz National Bank reports that Kyrgyzstan has started domestically printing banknotes of the Kyrgyz som, the country's currency, for the first time since independence.
Researchers at Binghamton University have developed a mathematical strategy that can solve Wordle with a 99% success rate.
In simulations, the information theory method successfully solved 99% of Wordle puzzles. The common letter strategy solved 90%.
Shannon entropy is a mathematical way of measuring uncertainty. In simple terms, it can help determine how much useful information a particular choice is expected to reveal.
